text:
mike_h: Kicking off a hybrid quant smoke run for new-llama3-7B (onboard intake). Goal: find cheapest config that meets quality budget for chat and summarization.
mike_h: Plan: baseline fp16 -> fp8 static -> int8 per-channel -> gguf package. Calib sets: 5k convo turns + 1k summarization pairs. Evaluation: ppl, rouge-l, exact-match on a few eval slices.
tara: +1. Do we have the ingestion script for the convo turns? prefer mix of short/long contexts.
jenr: I uploaded convo_5k_mixed.json to s3://rwd-ml/onboard/calib/1890/ earlier today.
sam_dev: For int8 calibration let's do 1024 warmup steps and 2k samples for kl calibration. Keep the batch small (bs=4) to preserve activation distribution.
mike_h: noted. Running fp8 baseline now then int8. Will paste logs.
quant-bot: fp8 baseline build started for model=llama3-7b, backend=ggml-fp8, run_id=run-1890456789-01
mike_h: fp8 eval finished quick pass. metrics:
```
- ppl_chat: 9.2 (baseline fp16: 8.9)
- rouge-l_summ: 42.6 (baseline: 43.1)
- qa_exact_match: 77.8 (baseline: 78.3)
```
jenr: fp8 looks within tolerance for a smoke check. Good baseline to compare int8.
quant-bot: starting int8-perchannel calibration (symmetric) sample=2048, calib_mode=kl
mike_h: int8 run finished. quick metrics:
```
- ppl_chat: 9.9  (+0.7)
- rouge-l_summ: 41.0  (-1.6)
- qa_exact_match: 76.1  (-1.7)
- avg_latency_tok: +12% vs fp8
```
sam_dev: int8 degraded rouge/EM more than I expected. Did we use per-layer scale or global?
mike_h: per-channel scales enabled. We used outlier clipping at 99.9 percentile.
jenr: Could be calibration set shift. Try toggling outlier_percentile=99.5 and rerun for a smaller sample to sanity check.
quant-bot: sanity-check run queued: run-1890456789-03 (outlier_percentile=99.5, sample=1024)
mike_h: sanity check complete. metrics:
```
- ppl_chat: 9.6
- rouge-l_summ: 41.8
- qa_exact_match: 76.8
```
mike_h: improvement but still ~0.5-0.8 EM loss vs fp8 baseline.
nathan_ml: We should also try hybrid: keep first N layers fp8 and last M layers int8. Often preserves task-specific heads.
sam_dev: agree. Suggest split at 30% bottom layers fp8, top 70% int8 per-channel.
jenr: I'll spin a hybrid config: bottom_layers=24 (fp8), top_layers=56 (int8) — model has 80 total.
quant-bot: hybrid run started run-1890456789-05 config=fp8-bottom24_int8-top56
mike_h: hybrid run metrics (quick):
```
- ppl_chat: 9.1
- rouge-l_summ: 42.4
- qa_exact_match: 78.0
- cost_estimate: ~0.62x fp16 token-cost
```
jenr: wow hybrid hit nearly baseline EM and rouge while reducing cost. latency impact moderate.
sam_dev: We should record decode-time fallback: if confidence drop or LM logprob delta > 3.0, route to fp8 variant for that request.
mike_h: good call. I'll add fallback policy in the routing config: "logprob_delta_threshold": 3.0, "fallback_model": "llama3-7b-fp8".
quant-bot: calibration artifacts saved: s3://rwd-ml/onboard/1890/hybrid-run-05/{calib.json,gguf.tar.gz,eval_report.json}
jenr: Quick note: the eval_report includes per-slice breakdown. For long-context summarization the hybrid variant still drops ~0.6 rouge vs fp16; acceptable for now.
mike_h: Decision proposal: promote hybrid fp8-bottom24/int8-top56 as "fastpath" for hosted inference with automatic fallback to fp8 when per-request logprob delta>3.0. Put int8-full as experimental until we improve calib.
tara: +1 from infra side for autoscaling cost model if we promote this. Need perf numbers for capacity planning.
sam_dev: I'll run a 12h soak on dedicated pool with batching on to measure throughput/cost. Will report tomorrow.
jenr: Also creating a follow-up ticket: ONBOARD-1122 (move hybrid->canary, add rollout policy, add eval hooks). I'll link the s3 artifacts.
mike_h: perfect. Follow-ups: 1) stability soak 12h 2) add per-route fallback 3) try int8 with mixed-scaling (per-tensor) and run the eval harness 4) longer eval set (10k) for final signoff.
quant-bot: run_summary: model=llama3-7b, chosen_config=hybrid_fp8bottom24_int8top56, delta_vs_fp16: EM -0.3, rouge-l -0.7, cost_est ~0.62x
nathan_ml: Nice. Let's also log the important config snippet for posterity:
```
{ "quant_scheme": "hybrid", "fp8_bottom_layers": 24, "int8_top_layers": 56, "calib_samples": 2048, "outlier_percentile": 99.5, "fallback": {"threshold_logprob_delta": 3.0, "model": "llama3-7b-fp8"} }
```
mike_h: Thanks all. I'll open the canary rollout PR and tag @tara for infra review.
jenr: :thumbsup:
tara: ack, will review PR and plan capacity for canary.
mike_h: closing thread for now; will post soak results in ~24h. :rocket:
